metadata.article_title: Production of documents or electronic records which another person, having possession, could refuse to produce

article.title: Production of documents or electronic records which another person, having possession, could refuse to produce
article.content:
136Production of documents or electronic records which another person, having possession, could refuse to produce

Section 136 · Part IV · Chapter IX
No one shall be compelled to produce documents in his possession or electronic records under his control, which any other person would be entitled to refuse to produce if they were in his possession or control, unless such last-mentioned person consents to their production.
